resources.string: Keeps the proximity screen-off gesture running
Cover the sensor to turn the screen off. It wakes when uncovered, without locking.
Turn the screen off by covering the proximity sensor. The screen wakes when the sensor is uncovered and the device is not locked. There is no launcher icon; use the Proximit Quick Settings tile.
